exact_prompts.concept-sheet-first-attempt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: worked-timber arch-crown surface-treatment concept sheet for later modeling reference; output one named image, concept-sheet.png.
Primary request: Show the KIT-WT appearance treatment for the curved crown/ring patches of one documented arch-2m/v1 host. This is a flush surface treatment on a fixed carrier, not a separate structural arch ring member. Make the complete treated arch carrier the dominant view, with consistent front elevation, side section through Y, patch/contact diagram and design-target dimensions.
Scene/backdrop: plain light neutral studio background.
Subject: One arch-2m/v1 carrier. Exact target envelope 2.0 m wide (local X) × 0.5 m deep (local Y) × 3.0 m tall (local Z). In local XZ, outer shape is rectangle [0,2]×[0,2] plus an upper semicircle centered (1,2), radius 1 m. Empty opening subtracts rectangle (0.5,1.5)×[0,2] plus an upper semicircle with the same center and radius 0.5 m. Extrude unchanged through Y. Minimum-grid-corner origin (0,0,0), 0.5 m grid. Keep the aperture entirely empty. Apply warm worked-timber grain flush only to the curved upper crown/ring patches from the two spring points around the semicircle; show front/back patch surfaces and the inner curved reveal. Leave straight jambs, base/threshold, door and window interface patches neutral gray. Mark seams at both spring points to the separate ArchOpeningJamb treatment. No material volume or geometry change.
Style/medium: precise polished game construction concept illustration; worked timber is dressed warm brown wood with controlled grain and restrained tool marks, matching a carefully finished frontier kit; no metal.
Composition/framing: one large dominant three-quarter full carrier; smaller views show only the same carrier and treatment. Clear section through Y depth, exact contact labels and patch extent.
Lighting/mood: even neutral studio lighting with soft contact shadows.
Color palette: warm medium brown wood against a neutral gray carrier.
Materials/textures: smooth dressed timber appearance; grain follows the arch curve as a surface pattern, no individual voussoir blocks, wedges, keystone or seams that imply geometry.
Text (verbatim): render only these exact target labels clearly: “Envelope target: 2.0 m × 0.5 m × 3.0 m”; “Opening target: 1.0 m clear width; spring line z=2.0 m”; “Outer radius: 1.0 m”; “Inner radius: 0.5 m”; “Grid: 0.5 m”; “X width / Y depth / Z height”; “Crown treatment meets jamb at spring points”. These are contract design targets, not image measurements.
Constraints: exact arch silhouette and empty opening; the treatment stays flush and inside the existing carrier envelope; no unsupported geometry or gameplay properties.
Avoid: separate ring parts, wedge stones, keystone, threshold board, door leaf, window, hardware, floor tiles, plinth, cutaway, extra objects, unreadable pseudo-labels, watermark.
